daily_prayers.title: A Prayer for New Beginnings

scripture_theme.text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

daily_prayers.content: Father, with the sunrise, I remember Your faithful love. I leave yesterday behind and step into the new grace You have for me today. Order my steps and let my life bring You glory. In Jesus' name, Amen.

daily_prayers.title: A Prayer for Strength and Guidance

scripture_theme.text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

daily_prayers.content: Lord, I wait on You now. Renew my strength for this day. Be my wisdom in decisions, my patience in challenges, and my strength in weakness. I look to You alone. In Jesus' name, Amen.

daily_prayers.title: A Prayer of Surrender

scripture_theme.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

daily_prayers.content: Lord, I lift my soul to You. I trust not in myself, but in Your lovingkindness. Speak to me today and show me the way I should walk. My life is in Your hands. Amen.

daily_prayers.title: A Prayer for Peaceful Rest

scripture_theme.text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

daily_prayers.content: Father, as I lay down, I receive Your peace. Thank You for Your protection today. Guard my mind and heart as I sleep, and renew my body for Your service. In Jesus' name, Amen.

daily_prayers.title: A Prayer of Reflection and Release

scripture_theme.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

daily_prayers.content: Lord, search my heart from today. Forgive my failures and wash me clean. I release every worry and burden to You. Hold me through the night. Amen.

daily_prayers.title: A Prayer of Thanksgiving

scripture_theme.text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night.

daily_prayers.content: Heavenly Father, as the day ends, I thank You. Thank You for Your constant presence, for the blessings, and even for the challenges. Your faithfulness was with me every moment. I rest in Your love. Amen.
